Maintainer ruling recorded — skills seat, session `session_01HZfg2AwVX191qCizp88gQr`, 2026-09-16T02:14Z. On the direct channel, after the objectui seat's report on objectui PR #9578 (a `Clause-②: yes` card whose in-seat PASS the harness classifier refused as `[Self-Approval]`), the seat put this two-sentence shape to the maintainer, verbatim:

> 1. 条款②复核 = 派发席在契约复审档席内做,记录写档位读数;不再有「只在 spec 席」。
> 2. 新 `packages/spec` 工作仍由 spec 席认领(现行规则,零延迟成本);顺手触 spec 的已派发卡照旧不转席。

The maintainer's answer, verbatim: 「同意」 (2026-09-16, after 02:14Z). Earlier in the same exchange the maintainer's own words on the question were 「他自己有fable ,再转别的pm不是找事吗?效率低几个数量级啊」 and 「spec 席的独占只保留给真正动 packages/spec 的 diff ,这个有价值吗?都是 fable 的子agent 在复核,哪个项目经理在派有区别吗」 — the ruling keeps sentence 2 as dispatch routing (coherence of the contract, zero latency), not as a review handoff.

Direction for this card, re-keyed by the ruling: (1) SKILL.md :513 「契约复审档复核只在 spec 席」 and :523 「契约复审档留给 skills 席与 spec 席的条款②复核,其余席位 ⛔ 永不起该档子代理」 become tier-bound — a `Clause-②: yes` card is reviewed in-seat by its dispatching seat when that seat's session measures at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (`get_session`: `configured_model` = `session_context.model` = `last_served_model`), the record carrying `Served-tier:` and the reading; a seat NOT at the tier still may not review a clause-② card and does not spawn the tier subagent; `contract-review.md` :24–:25 (「spec 席达档审契约增量;余席默认档自审」) follows the same re-key; the SELF-REVIEW machine reading (:37) and the independence pair are untouched; sentence 2 needs no text change (:527–:528 already say it). (2) One `platform-readings.md` row for the classifier reading (a PASS verdict on a PR the same session dispatched can be refused by content, with the objectui measurement). Rules layer for (1) — four-piece + an authorized APPROVED — at the review tier (SKILL.md path mandate); references tier for (2), same PR. Budget: SKILL.md 812 / 812, core-rules 151 / 151, contract-review 60 / 60 — in-place re-keys only. Dispatch follows once PR #18327 (SKILL.md :89) has landed — it is in the merge queue now.
